title: ZIP's EOCD can be annotated
summary: The fixed part of a classic EOCD is 22 bytes, and can be followed by up to 65535 bytes of comments at the end.
detail: Checking for signatures only at exactly 22 bytes from the end of the file will miss annotated archives; the length of comments for candidate records should match the actual boundaries.
boundary: The annotation itself can contain signature bytes. A single magic number is not sufficient to prove that true EOCD has been found.
relevance: When judging whether the directory is complete from the end of the attachment, comments and missing records can be distinguished.
